description: This file implements a directory listing utility within the Chromium project's net namespace, including classes and methods for enumerating directory contents, sorting entries, and handling asynchronous operations.

classes.name: DirectoryLister
classes.description: Manages asynchronous directory listing operations, including starting, canceling, and delegating results.

classes.name: DirectoryLister::Core
classes.description: Handles the core logic of directory enumeration, including file iteration, sorting, and cancellation.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::Start
methods.description: Initiates the directory listing operation on a background thread.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing directory listing operation.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::OnListFile
methods.description: Callback invoked for each file found during enumeration, delegates to the user-provided delegate.

methods.name: DirectoryLister::OnListDone
methods.description: Callback invoked when directory enumeration completes, delegates to the user-provided delegate.
